tickets.title: Update recurring payment instructions
tickets.text: Prepare transfer instructions for donating about $50,000 of Copper Firefly Utilities shares from Nora and Martin Nettlewhisk’s joint taxable brokerage account at Apricot Compass Advisory to Nora’s donor-advised fund at Velvet Acorn Charitable.
tickets.evidence: The agreed August 2 follow-up is to prepare transfer instructions for donating about $50,000 of Copper Firefly Utilities shares to Nora’s donor-advised fund at Velvet Acorn Charitable.
